name: §aNovice Pickaxe
story: Plain iron forged in haste. Fine for learning but quick to wear out.

name: §bExpert Sword
story: Honed by a veteran smith. Hits hard and stays quick through long fights.

name: §fField Shovel
story: A farmhand's tool. Gentle on the soil but not built to last.

name: §9Verdant Hatchet
story: Heavy head cuts deep but swings slowly. Its sturdy handle outlasts most.

name: §9Gale Recurve
story: Slender limbs make it accurate but slow to draw and fairly delicate.

name: §dDeepstone Drill
story: Reinforced to bore through the deepest rock. Tough and quick but light on damage.

name: §dWarden Edge
story: Forged from a fallen warden's core. Devastating and fast with solid endurance.

name: §6Astral Cleaver
story: Star-metal blade of crushing force. Nearly unbreakable though it swings at a moderate pace.

name: §6Voidfall Pickaxe
story: Pulled from the void itself. Strong and blazing fast and almost endless.

name: §aStonewake Pickaxe
story: Cheap iron for a young miner. Handy early on but wears out fast.

name: §aCoppervein Pickaxe
story: Gilded edge cuts copper veins cleanly. Sturdier than before but still modest.

name: §9Deepslate Prospector
story: Tempered in deepslate dust for steady work. Dependable but only mildly durable.

name: §9Redstone Extractor
story: Redstone-laced head tracks rich veins. Balanced strength with respectable endurance.

name: §dDiamond Seeker
story: Diamond tip bites harder into stone. Good power with lasting edges.

name: §dNether Delver
story: Hardened by Nether fire to resist wear. Strong blows and long life.

name: §dObsidian Breaker
story: Obsidian-forged for the toughest stone. Heavy hits that rarely dull.

name: §6Ancient Vein Pick
story: Old masterwork that has outlived its makers. Reliable strength and endurance.

name: §6Bedrock Borer
story: Built to chew through bedrock. Nearly impossible to wear down.

name: §6Worldshaper Pickaxe
story: Reshapes mountains with every swing. Peak power and unmatched durability.

name: §aSapling Cutter
story: Stone head chops hard but slowly. Chips and dulls quickly.

name: §aBark Stripper
story: Iron edge strips bark cleanly. Heavy swings and moderate wear.

name: §9Canopy Hatchet
story: Diamond edge splits thick branches. Slow heavy swings with modest durability.

name: §9Wildwood Axe
story: Netherite spine for wild timber. Heavy slow strikes and decent endurance.

name: §dHeartwood Chopper
story: Precision cut through the hardest heartwood. Strong but slow and steady.

name: §dCrimson Timber Axe
story: Tempered in crimson fungi to cleave Nether stems. Hard hitting and durable.

name: §dPalegrove Cleaver
story: Wide blade for ancient pale trunks. Slow to swing yet very durable.

name: §6Elderwood Hatchet
story: A forester's lifelong companion. Crushing blows and tough enough for decades.

name: §6Worldroot Axe
story: Grown from the roots of the world. Immense force that never fades.

name: §6Evergreen Reaper
story: Evergreen steel that reaps whole groves. Maximum force and endless endurance.

name: §aFirst Harvest Hoe
story: Simple stone hoe. Light and fast but weak and short lived.

name: §aFieldhand Hoe
story: Iron blade made for daily work. Quick to swing and reasonably sturdy.

name: §9Cropkeeper Hoe
story: Balanced for tending crops all day. Swift swings but gentle damage.

name: §9Harvest Warden
story: Reinforced to guard the harvest. Rapid swings and solid durability.

name: §dGolden Furrow
story: Golden edge turns soil swiftly. Light hits and lasting reliability.

name: §dBountiful Planter
story: Made to plant entire fields. Very fast and built to last.

name: §dOrchard Keeper
story: Trimmed countless orchards. Nimble swings and long lasting craftsmanship.

name: §6Everbloom Hoe
story: Blooms again after every harvest. Fast swings and remarkable endurance.

name: §6World Harvester
story: Reaps whole fields in moments. Blinding speed and almost unbreakable.

name: §6Eternal Harvest Hoe
story: Said to harvest endlessly. Top speed and the strongest hoe ever made.

name: §aTrailwatch Bow
story: Plain wood bow for tracking trails. Accurate but slow and fragile.

name: §aPathfinder Crossbow
story: Mechanical trigger for steady aim. Slow to reload and moderately sturdy.

name: §9Beasttracker Blade
story: Light iron blade for close hunts. Quick and sharp with modest durability.

name: §9Wildstalker Bow
story: Seasoned yew limbs endure long treks. Steady aim but slow draw.

name: §dApex Crossbow
story: Winched for deadly force. Heavy bolts slow reload and good durability.

name: §dDragonfang Sword
story: Carved from dragon fang for lethal sharpness. Fast strikes and strong endurance.

name: §dDreadhunter Blade
story: Dread-forged against the realm's nightmares. Swift lethal and very durable.

name: §6Ender Tracker Bow
story: Tuned to hit foes across dimensions. Powerful and tough but slow to draw.

name: §6Wardenbreaker Sword
story: Made to defy wardens. Crushing damage and nearly unbreakable steel.

name: §6Legend of the Hunt
story: Whispered about in every camp. Perfect balance of power speed and endurance.

name: §aGroundbreaker Shovel
story: Stone blade for a first dig. Decent bite but dulls quickly.

name: §aDune Walker Spade
story: Light spade for sand and gravel. Even pace and fair endurance.

name: §9Clay Delver
story: Smooth diamond edge scoops clay cleanly. Average speed and modest durability.

name: §9Gravel Prospector
story: Reinforced against gravel and rock. Steady rhythm and solid wear resistance.

name: §dSoul Sand Spade
story: Draws strength from soul sand. Hits harder with reliable durability.

name: §dTerracotta Breaker
story: Heavy head for breaking broad ground. Strong and long lasting.

name: §dRuin Prospector
story: Delicate brush for buried ruins. Gentle touch but surprisingly durable.

name: §6Strata Shaper
story: Cuts every layer of earth evenly. Strong and tough with steady speed.

name: §6Deep Digger
story: Dug the deepest shafts ever recorded. Strong and nearly unbreakable.

name: §6Earthshaper Spade
story: Moves earth like water. Immense power and endless durability.
